text.description_html:
Design Hardware 416 High Performance Door Closer

Design Hardware offers you solutions proven to fit every application from the heaviest use to the most prestigious and even the aesthetically pleasing. You will find their high quality products in residential and commercial projects around the world.

Spring Power Adjustment allows for a range of sizes 1-6.

416 Design Hardware Specs:

  • Independent Latch Speed, Sweep Speed and Back Check controls.
  • UL Listed.
  • Needle bearing for smooth operation.
  • Complies with ADA reduced opening force including Barrier Free.
  • Complies with ANSI A156.4 Grade 1 standards.
  • Heavy Duty Cast Iron Body.
  • Non Handed - can be installed Right or Left.
  • Each Closer comes complete with Molded Cover
  • Non Handed Fasteners - Phillips head Wood and Machine Screws.

Installation Guide: Click here to download. (PDF).


** Item Discontinued: Use Global TC4300, LCN 4040XP or Deltana DC40 replacement door closer.
